$comment: Files this fork intentionally keeps diverged from upstream (Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-claudecode). On sync, /fork-sync forces human-reviewed 3-way resolution for these instead of silently taking upstream — a naive merge could otherwise revert an override (e.g. flip auto-update back to the upstream owner). Build artifacts (dist/**, bridge/**) are NOT overlays: they are regenerated by the verify step. Doc translations / seminar content are fork distribution-identity content but low-risk and intentionally omitted to keep this list to high-stakes guards.

overlays.reason: REPO_OWNER='salemaziel' — auto-update must target the fork, NOT upstream. Silent revert would make the fork self-update from Yeachan-Heo.
crossProviderOrder uses 'antigravity' instead of 'gemini' — default provider swap (PR #5).
plugin repository/homepage point at salemaziel fork — distribution identity.
marketplace source points at salemaziel fork — distribution identity.
upgrade-test repointed to fork release endpoint.
